purpose: Manual listening record for the Qwen3-TTS speech-tokenizer decoder closeout. Valid-region WAVs are the primary listening artifacts; full padded WAVs are listed in the audio-inspection reports for debugging only.
candidate: bucketed fp16 base with W8A8 activation quantization scoped to linear + matmul

listen_in_order.listen_for: Obvious buzz, dullness, warble, transient smearing, or pronunciation change relative to fp16.
listen_in_order.airpods_listening_note: W8A8 was very close to fp16. The fp16 baseline came in a tiny bit stronger and fuller, but the difference was small enough to be acceptable for continued ANE-oriented performance work.

listen_in_order.listen_for: Late-sentence drift, roughness around high-diff windows, cadence change, or any artifact that would block W8A8 decoder use.
listen_in_order.airpods_listening_note: W8A8 sounded a bit muffled, like a lower-quality microphone recording compared with fp16. It was definitely not as good as fp16, but the difference was not large enough to block continued performance work if end-to-end performance improves.

acceptance_note: AirPods 4 listening found the W8A8 linear + matmul decoder acceptable for continued Core ML performance exploration, but not quality-equal to fp16. A real-headphones or speakers pass remains optional before any final backend-quality decision.
